text: Bronze is faithful but untyped. This video builds the real Silver transformation: a Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline that parses, types, and dedupes claims into harborview.silver.claims_clean.
Two decisions matter: how the claim gets cleaned, and how strictly two new data-quality expectations get enforced -- checking a positive claim amount and a non-null clinic id.
Using pyspark.pipelines, the current Lakeflow API, claims_clean is defined with the dp.table decorator, and both expectations are attached with dp.expect -- Lakeflow's warn severity.
Warn logs a violation but keeps the row; drop removes it; fail halts the pipeline. We chose warn on purpose -- it's week one, and a legitimate edge case could look like bad data.
Silver is live, with full visibility into every rule violation in the event log. Next: the two Gold tables built on top of this clean claims stream.
